groups.problem: The Lithuanian totpStep1/loginTotpStep1 translations were replaced with Italian text in the lt account and login message files.
groups.rationale: All three report the same wrong-language replacement in the lt files. S1 names both files, and S3 and S4 each name one of them.

groups.problem: In the admin-ui and account-ui JS bundles, error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed from i18next {{0}} placeholders to Java MessageFormat/ICU choice syntax, which i18next cannot interpolate.
groups.rationale: It is the same broken contract in the two JS bundles, and one change of approach fixes both: keep the double-brace form for the JS bundles.

groups.problem: The prefix/suffix trimming in the difference report can make start exceed length-end, so substring() throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
groups.rationale: All three point at the same unclamped substring computation on lines 99-111.
